title: On Permutation Trinomials and Complete Permutation Polynomials via Fiber Criteria over Finite Fields
summary: We give new, short proofs of recent permutation polynomial results of Bousalmi, Bayad, and Derbal by reducing the verification to explicit computations on a three-element multiplicative subgroup via Zieve's fiber criterion. Building on this approach, we develop a general framework -- combining Zieve's theorem with the AGW criterion -- for constructing complete permutation polynomials over finite fields through a fiber decomposition over the cube roots of unity.
